candidate.definition_en: To excrete moisture through the pores of the skin, typically due to heat or exertion.
candidate.explanation_ar: إن جسمك يفرز ميه 'عرق' لما الجو يكون حر أو تعمل مجهود.

senses.definition_en: To excrete moisture through the pores of the skin, typically due to heat or exertion.
senses.explanation_ar: أن يفرز الجسم العرق من مسام الجلد نتيجة الحرارة أو المجهود البدني.
examples: I sweat when it is hot.
He began to sweat after running.
The athletes sweat a lot during training.
